individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot in which each marker is an individual sample (n=141); the marginal histograms show the raw distributions. Individual data points are inherently the data displayed.
Scatter-type plot (each symbol = one cell-line model) with error bars; scatter plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Line/density plots showing fitted normal/gamma distributions per subtype; line plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Box plot (exempt by type) that additionally overlays individual sample data points (colored dots per reporter) on top of the boxes.
Polar histograms display the full distribution of phase differences per cell line (color-coded individually), analogous to a distribution/histogram plot which does not require overlaid points.
Polar histogram summarizing phase-difference distribution by subtype; histogram/distribution-type plot, exempt from individual-point overlay requirement.
Single representative raw signal trace with fitted curve illustrating the fitting approach; this is itself raw/individual data, not an averaged summary statistic.
Scatter plot where each marker represents an individual sample (n=117) with fit-uncertainty error bars; scatter plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
